title: High-Throughput Generative Video Super-Resolution on a Single Consumer GPU
title_zh: 生成式视频超分辨率（VSR）（Video Super-Resolution）

paragraphs.en: 该研究提出了一种无需端到端重新训练即可在单台高端消费级 GPU 上实现高清生成式视频超分辨率的框架。 Generative video super-resolution (VSR) can recover visually compelling high-frequency detail by leveraging diffusion priors, but iterative sampling and heavy spatio-temporal coupling make practical deployments difficult. We study a different operating point: practical HD generative VSR on a single high-end consumer GPU without end-to-end retraining. To this end, we present a zero-shot framework built entirely from pretrained components. The proposed system decouples spatial enhancement from temporal stabilization. A time-distilled one-step diffusion backbone handles spatial upscaling, while temporal coherence is promoted by a lightweight pretrained flow-based interpolator that synthesizes intermediate frames between super-resolved keyframes. To further improve scalability, we introduce a resolution-aware hybrid attention scheme that, in a zero-shot manner, replaces selected high-resolution global-attention layers with neighborhood attention while preserving global attention in semantically critical low-resolution layers, while also improving temporal consistency. Experiments show that the proposed framework reaches up to ~32 FPS at 720p resolution under interleaved inference on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090. At 4K, the proposed attention substitution can yield up to a 44% speedup over the original attention implementation. Across standard VSR benchmarks, the method consistently shifts the speed-quality trade-off decisively toward runtime efficiency, trading reconstruction fidelity for strong no-reference perceptual quality, while remaining reasonably competitive against generative approaches in temporal consistency. It also exposes clear limitations in handling more challenging motion, which a simple motion gate partially mitigates. Code will be released upon acceptance.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究提出了一种无需端到端重新训练即可在单台高端消费级 GPU 上实现高清生成式视频超分辨率的框架。生成式视频超分辨率（VSR）可以通过利用扩散先验恢复视觉上令人信服的高频细节，但迭代采样和强烈的时空耦合使得实际部署变得困难。 我们研究了一种不同的运行模式：在单台高端消费级 GPU 上实现无需端到端重新训练的实际高清生成式 VSR。 为此，我们提出了一种完全由预训练组件构建的零样本框架。 所提出的系统将空间增强与时间稳定解耦。 一个经过时间蒸馏的单步扩散主干网络负责空间上采样，而时间一致性则由一个轻量级的预训练流基插值器促进，该插值器可在超分辨率关键帧之间合成中间帧。 为了进一步提升可扩展性，我们引入了一种分辨率感知的混合注意力机制：以零样本方式，将选定的高分辨率全局注意力层替换为邻域注意力，同时保留语义关键的低分辨率层中的全局注意力，并进一步提升了时间一致性。 实验表明，在单台 NVIDIA RTX 4090 上进行交错推理时，该框架在 720p 分辨率下最高可达约 32 FPS。 在 4K 分辨率下，所提出的注意力替换方法相比原始注意力实现最多可提升 44% 的速度。 在标准 VSR 基准测试中，该方法始终将速度-质量权衡明确地向运行时效率方向偏移：以重建保真度换取强大的无参考感知质量，同时在时间一致性方面仍与生成式方法保持合理竞争力。 该框架在处理更具挑战性的运动时也存在明显局限性，而一个简单的运动门控机制可在一定程度上缓解这一问题。 代码将在论文被接受后发布。
